notes.title: Turbo Fat 1.0005: Stability improvements and bug fixes
notes.notes:
Disabled threading to improve stability.
 Tweaked scene transitions to prevent crashes after levels finish.
 Reduced the number of Steam API calls.
 Fixed a bug where fat creatures on the Avatar screen were saved as skinny.
 Improved Spanish localization and fixed an issue with language settings not using game preferences.
 Fixed a bug where the camera sometimes didn't shift to the next customer in Adventure Mode.
 Fixed receipt shake effect on the results screen.
 Fixed occasional issues with Steam achievements returning bad data.
 Added a few new friends from the community Discord.
 Cleaned up a few cutscene dialogue typos.

notes.title: Engine improvements, bugfixes
notes.notes:
After two months exploring the new version of the Godot engine, it seems it's not quite ready for the awesome features required by Turbo Fat yet -- so we're sticking with the older version!

However all is not lost, as we've ported a few of the coolest improvements and bugfixes from our exploratory work into the older version of the engine, including a few bugs reported by the Turbo Fat community, and retroactively applying fixes to our tween and particle systems to make things run more smoothly.

We're starting work on a fun new tropical area, and we can't wait to share it with you. Stay tuned!
